title: Rendley AI Video Agent
description: Describe the video or the edit, add your files, and the Rendley AI agent does the work on a real editing timeline. A run starts the job and exits by default; pick the result up with Job ID, or turn on Wait for completion.

rendley_api_key.title: Rendley API key
rendley_api_key.description: Create one at https://app.rendley.com/settings. The agent and renders need an active Rendley subscription with credits.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: What the agent should create or change, for example "Cut this interview down to a 30-second teaser with captions" or "Make a 15-second product teaser from these clips". Leave it empty only when Job ID is set.
prompt.prefill: Create a short, engaging social-media video using high-quality stock footage. Use an interesting, modern layout with dynamic cuts, varied framing, and smooth transitions. Add bold, clean text overlays on top of the footage, with the text appearing at key moments and remaining easy to read. Keep the overall style polished, energetic, visually appealing, and concise.

files.title: Files
files.description: Public URLs of clips, images or audio for the agent to work with. Leave empty when the prompt only uses generated media or the project's existing files.

project_id.title: Project ID
project_id.description: Leave empty to create a new project for this run. Set it to edit an existing Rendley project instead.
project_id.sectionDescription: By default each run creates a new project in your first workspace. The run log lists your workspaces with their IDs.

workspace_id.title: Workspace
workspace_id.description: Only used when a project is created. Leave empty for your first workspace, or give another workspace's name or ID.

thread_id.title: Thread ID
thread_id.description: Continue a previous agent conversation by passing the thread_id from an earlier run together with its project_id.

render.title: Export a video file
render.description: Export the finished project to a video file once the agent is done. Turn off to keep the edited project in Rendley Studio and continue editing it there.

resolution.title: Resolution
resolution.description: Output resolution of the rendered video.

quality.title: Quality
quality.description: Encoding quality of the rendered video.

codec.title: Format
codec.description: H.264 produces an MP4; VP8 produces a WebM.

job_id.title: Job ID
job_id.description: The ID of a job from an earlier run, the agent_job_id or the export job_id from its dataset item. The run fetches that job instead of starting a new one, and the other inputs are ignored. Turn on Wait for completion to have the run wait until it is finished.
job_id.sectionDescription: By default a run starts the agent and exits. Put the job ID from that run's dataset item here to fetch the result, and add Wait for completion if it should wait.

wait_for_completion.title: Wait for completion
wait_for_completion.description: Off by default, so the run starts the job on Rendley and exits within seconds, which keeps Apify compute at a minimum. Get the result later by running the Actor again with the job ID from the dataset item in Job ID. Turn this on to have this run stay open until the job is finished and return the result itself. It waits until two minutes before the run's timeout (one hour by default, settable per run) and, if the job is still going, reports it as running for a later run to pick up. Agent edits take minutes and an export takes about a minute.

save_to_kvs.title: Copy the video to the key-value store
save_to_kvs.description: Stream the exported video into this run's key-value store as OUTPUT_VIDEO, so there is a link that does not expire. Rendley's own download URLs expire after a few hours. The file is streamed, so the smallest memory setting is enough.

api_base_url.title: API base URL
api_base_url.description: Leave empty unless Rendley gave you a different API host.
